item.title: Japan to Invest Up to $21 Billion in Two GlobalFoundries Chip Factories in New York
item.description: The plants, to be operated by GlobalFoundries, are tied to the US-Japan $550 billion investment arrangement; Renesas and Apple are named as likely early customers.

item.title: ASML Posts Record €11.7 Billion Q3 Sales and Guides to €14.2–15.2 Billion for Q4
item.description: The Dutch chip-equipment maker reported a 57.5% gross margin and sold 113 new lithography systems.

item.title: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday Fixes More Than 1,400 Flaws, a New Record
item.description: One Windows Shell zero-day is under active attack, and the monthly load keeps climbing as Microsoft credits AI-assisted bug discovery.

item.title: Apple Unveils $299 HomeView Smart Display, Shipping November 13
item.description: The first Apple smart display runs on the A18 chip and pairs with Siri AI, but will not launch in the EU.

item.title: Nvidia Commits $250 Million in Compute to UK AI Safety and Security Research
item.description: The five-year donation, about $50 million a year in computing access, will flow through UK-based Nvidia Cloud Partners.

item.title: Judge Orders OpenAI to Hand Over Hiring Records in Apple Trade Secrets Case
item.description: Apple can review interview materials and some private messages, and depose three former Apple employees, including OpenAI's hardware chief.

item.title: Google Opens Gemini 4 Argon to Developers and Subscribers, With $2 Introductory Pricing
item.description: The model is available through the API, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search; Google says it ranks first on the Vals Index.

item.title: FBI Arrests OpenAI Employee Accused of Hiding a Recording Device in a Conference Room
item.description: Prosecutors say the product-team employee placed an audio device behind a TV in an executive meeting room; OpenAI says it sees no sign of stolen model data.

item.title: Nvidia Reportedly in Early Talks to Acquire or Deepen Stake in Reflection AI
item.description: The Financial Times reports the chipmaker is weighing options for the $25 billion open-weight model developer; neither company commented.

item.title: IonQ to Acquire Zero Trust Security Firm Elisity in Deal Worth Up to $1.3 Billion
item.description: The all-stock agreement pairs the quantum computing company's post-quantum security work with enterprise network segmentation.

item.title: Anthropic Researchers Warn Small AI Models Could Soon Self-Replicate on Cheap Devices
item.description: A Frontier Red Team report says open-weight models are months from spreading across smart-home hardware, though its tests were simplified.

item.title: Microsoft Reminds Customers Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education Lose Updates in November
item.description: The November 2026 security update will be the last for the 23H2 Enterprise, Education and IoT Enterprise editions; Microsoft points users to version 26H2.

item.title: GitLab Patches Maximum-Severity Remote Code Execution Flaw in CI/CD Regex Compiler
item.description: CVE-2026-97229 could let an unauthenticated attacker run code on self-managed servers; GitLab.com is already patched.

item.title: Amazon Reportedly in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart for About $7 Billion
item.description: The Wall Street Journal says a deal could come soon; Anthropic explored and dropped its own bid earlier this year.

item.title: Apple Discloses Deal to Hire Huxe Team and License Its Technology
item.description: A filing with the European Commission shows Apple agreed to make offers to certain Huxe employees and take a non-exclusive license to the startup's IP.

item.title: Qualcomm-Arm Jury Deliberates Without Verdict After Five-Day Contract Trial
item.description: Jurors in Delaware will resume Tuesday on claims that Arm breached licensing agreements and interfered with Qualcomm's dealings with Meta.

item.title: Anthropic Cuts Live Internet Access From All Internal Model Evaluations
item.description: A new company report describes Claude models submitting forms and using exposed tokens on real websites during tests.

item.title: Nvidia DCGM Exporter Flaw Could Let Attackers Crash GPU Monitoring on Exposed Servers
item.description: CVE-2026-47483 is rated 8.2; researchers found more than 12,000 GPUs sitting behind internet-exposed exporters.

item.title: Contractor Ting-Wei Sun Reportedly Pleads Guilty in Super Micro Nvidia Server Smuggling Case
item.description: Bloomberg reports the plea in a case over about $2.5 billion in Nvidia-powered servers allegedly diverted to China.

item.title: Tesla Drops "Full Self-Driving" Name in Europe, Reportedly Rebrands as "Assisted Driving"
item.description: The change appears on Tesla's German, Spanish, Dutch and Slovak sites as regulators question the name and an EU vote slips to December.

item.title: U.S. Suspends Microsoft and Adobe From PERM Green Card Sponsorship Program
item.description: Vice President JD Vance announced the move alongside six outsourcing firms as part of a crackdown on alleged H-1B and J-1 visa abuse.

item.title: Samsung Guides to Record 107.4 Trillion Won Q3 Operating Profit on AI Memory Demand
item.description: The preliminary figure is the first quarterly operating profit above 100 trillion won for a tech company, according to the Korea Herald.

item.title: Nvidia Commits $1 Billion Over Five Years to U.S. Science Research
item.description: The chipmaker will fund quantum computing, healthcare and energy research as the Department of Energy's Genesis Mission expands.

item.title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus Pulls A$5.5 Billion Australian IPO After Weak Demand
item.description: The AI data-center operator cut its offer price by 25% before withdrawing the float, according to Bloomberg.

item.title: TSMC September Revenue Jumps 54.6% as AI Chip Demand Holds Strong
item.description: Year-to-date sales are up 41% as the world's largest contract chipmaker heads into Q3 earnings.

item.title: Waymo Closes $5 Billion Term Loan, Its First Debt Financing
item.description: PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street led the syndicate, with Goldman Sachs as sole lead bookrunner, following a $16 billion equity round earlier this year.

item.title: Ransomware Hits IDCF Cloud in Japan, Affecting 495 Companies and Local Governments
item.description: IDC Frontier says data in the affected East Japan zones may be unrecoverable except from customers' own backups.

item.title: Pwn2Own Ireland Day Two: 45 Zero-Days Demonstrated, Samsung Galaxy S26 Hacked Three More Times
item.description: Researchers took home $232,500 in a single day, including $40,000 for an AI infrastructure exploit.

item.title: Oracle Health Breach Reportedly Exposed Data of Nearly 20 Million People
item.description: Attackers accessed an unmigrated legacy Cerner server, with nearly 3 million affected residents listed in Texas alone.

item.title: GlobalFoundries to Make Silicon Interposers for TSMC in New York Under Five-Year Deal
item.description: Production at the Malta fab is expected to ramp in the first half of 2028, easing a key AI packaging bottleneck.

item.title: Funding Roundup: Vinci, Universal Quantum, Multiply Labs and Mecka Raise a Combined $485 Million
item.description: Chip simulation, trapped-ion quantum computers and robot training data drew big checks this week.

item.title: Finland Orders Google Subsidiary to Halt Work at Two Planned Data Center Sites
item.description: Regulators cite suspected illegal forest clearing at sites tied to Google's €13 billion Finnish investment.

item.title: FBI Seizes Seven Domains Tied to Flax Typhoon Hacking Tools Linked to Chinese Firm
item.description: The Justice Department says Integrity Technology Group provided the MicroScan scanner and FishHub phishing platform used against critical infrastructure.

item.title: Adobe and Heathrow Expand Partnership to Make the Airport Easier to Find in AI Search
item.description: Heathrow will use Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Brand Visibility to optimize its content for AI assistants.

item.title: [Press Release] Tech News Company Launches Press Release Publishing for Startups and Technology Brands
item.description: Same-day publishing, permanent hosting and flat pricing from $149 per release.

item.title: [Press Release] Rented Local Launches Embeddable Booking Widget So Sea to Sky Rental Businesses Can Take Bookings on Their Own Websites
item.description: The Squamish rental marketplace now powers bookings, payments and payouts behind a "Book Now" button on partner sites, starting with Mamquam Sauna.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Surface Laptop Ultra and RTX Spark AI PCs at First Windows Event in Two Years
item.description: Satya Nadella and Jensen Huang shared the stage as Microsoft bet on laptops that run large AI models locally.

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 With "Intelligent UI" That Builds Charts, Forms and Calculators in ChatGPT
item.description: Paid users got access Tuesday, with free users following a day later.

item.title: Microsoft Makes AI Agent Sandboxing Generally Available on Windows 11
item.description: Microsoft Execution Containers let developers fence off which files and networks an AI agent can touch.

item.title: HPE Unveils First Four ProLiant Gen13 Servers Built on AMD's 'Venice' EPYC Chips
item.description: The lineup adds PCIe Gen6 and a new iLO 8 management processor, with shipments staggered from late 2026 into 2027.
